scope: Read-only corrected audit of the original user-supplied Native-First plan against retained r4 receipts and r5 immutable continuation join; no runtime mutation, redispatch, replay, settlement, or production policy change.

acceptance_matrix.observed: The original 100-read/20-patch/20-readback receipt remains terminal and failed with ORIGINAL_JOB_IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED. Its immutable continuation/resume/readback chain verifies the same runtime and scope, all 20 patch/readback hashes, 10 native Node jobs, 3 native Git jobs, an explicitly approved build and artifact readback without original action replay.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: Retain the failed parent as chronology. No redispatch is required for completed lanes; semantic acceptance is evaluated separately.

acceptance_matrix.observed: 20/20 independent semantic lanes accepted with verifier/exit proof and no replay/cache reuse.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: The joined immutable receipt chain supplies the 100/20 end-to-end lane and native Job lineage; the independent semantic 20/20 gate remains separate.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Git status/diff without VM or global Git mutation
acceptance_matrix.observed: The same-runtime continuation chain verifies git_status, git_diff and git_log as three distinct native/process_container Jobs with task/action/attempt/receipt lineage and native_safe_command policy. The metadata grammar excludes global-config mutation and hostile helper execution.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: No Git redispatch is required. Semantic acceptance and AutoCAD UNKNOWN records remain separate.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Ten allowed CLI commands with complete native receipts
acceptance_matrix.observed: Ten distinct native Node Jobs are linked to task/action/attempt/receipt identities and unique Job/command/local handles under the same exact runtime identity. Continuation failures are retained; completed lanes are joined rather than repeated.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: No additional CLI redispatch is needed; semantic acceptance remains separate.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Approved build/test executes within granted limits
acceptance_matrix.observed: One explicitly approved native build Job with native_explicit_approval and linked artifact readback is verified. The artifact SHA-256 matches the build stdout marker within the immutable same-runtime chain.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: This meets the approved-build canary criterion for the granted Node command. Real .NET/AutoCAD compatibility is a separate gate before converting those command groups; it is not evidence supplied by this fixture.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Untrusted/high-risk code is isolated or denied
acceptance_matrix.observed: Isolated terminal Job exited 0; owned sandbox record/daemon/host and named memory aggregate disappeared; final aggregate was 0.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: The receipt itself notes no dedicated idle-teardown receipt; retain this as a live observation with that limitation.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Sandbox with no job stops safely and returns RAM
acceptance_matrix.observed: terminal_to_teardown_ms=390240; final_sandbox_working_set_bytes=0; no observer lifecycle mutation.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: No cold-start/peak baseline was measured; this proves safe observed teardown, not a universal RAM or latency reduction.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Reconnect/recovery preserves Job state and does not redispatch
acceptance_matrix.observed: Live overlap receipt reports client_transport_only reconnect, no_second_exec_verified=true, two distinct native Jobs, and closed tasks/writers.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: The original failed parent remains retained; completed native lanes are joined by immutable references. This is client-transport reconnect proof, not an unobserved network failure scenario.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Switch Codex-web <-> Autocad without wrong scope or writer lease
acceptance_matrix.observed: The live overlap used distinct exact bindings, workspace generations, tasks and writer leases for Codex-web and Autocad; both task/writer pairs terminalized. The policy isolated→native_first roundtrip changed only Codex-web while other_scope_unchanged=true and exact generation checks remained in force.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: This satisfies the original wrong-workspace/writer-lease criterion for the operated control-plane path. No extra renderer UI gesture is required by its wording.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Rollback to old runner without losing history
acceptance_matrix.observed: Live runner rollback was exercised as native_first→isolated→native_first for the same exact workspace/generation. Isolate/restore receipts share plan, epoch, parity, smoke and other-scope hashes; restored policy matches its original hash, and other_scope_unchanged=true. The isolated Job/idle teardown completed and readiness still preserves five historical UNKNOWN actions. Server source-only backup exists without SQLite restore.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: The original wording requires returning to the old runner without losing history, which this policy/runner roundtrip proves. It does not require a binary/service rollback. Binary rollback may be evaluated separately for a release; never restore SQLite or replay UNKNOWN actions.

acceptance_matrix.observed: Host token is non-elevated, medium integrity, and administrator group deny-only. Native child token is null/unknown because the CPython fixture exited 126 before token query; this is explicitly not evidence of child privilege absence.
acceptance_matrix.remaining: Use a working approved native child probe (for example Node) to capture child token facts, or record this criterion as not proven. Do not weaken policy to manufacture a pass.

autocad_unknown_disposition.policy: Keep these records reconcile_required; do not replay, settle, or use them as evidence for AutoCAD build/native approval.

bounded_next_actions: Retain original failed parent and all continuation receipts; use the same-runtime immutable join to report completed 100/20/10-CLI/Git/build/readback lanes without redispatch.
Keep independent semantic acceptance separate from the receipt join.
Keep child-token inspection as an explicit unproven security observation; a working probe can close that evidence gap without weakening policy.
Treat real .NET/AutoCAD build as a separate command-group conversion gate; preserve the three quarantined UNKNOWN records and do not grant broad prefixes from Node fixture proof.
no_claims: This audit does not rewrite a failed parent receipt into a monolithic sequential canary pass.
This audit does not claim .NET/AutoCAD build compatibility.
This audit does not claim native child token restriction.
This audit does not settle or replay any UNKNOWN action.
This audit does not require unnecessary CLI/file redispatch or binary service rollback.
